source_pin_audit.patch_scope: Complete four-file patch inspected; proposed file hashes were read from manifest but not independently reconstructed by applying patch.
source_pin_audit.v1: Keep gdn-output16-only-v1/DO_NOT_RUN.json and prior source review immutable; v1 remains blocked and unexecuted.

findings.evidence: The new entry checks nonnull arguments, T range and explicit in-order queue; arithmetic spans are checked, then state/h/gate/beta/z/gamma/y16 are each checked as a complete live registered device Allocation span in that queue context/device. Only afterward does it form h+2048 and h+4096 views and call recurrence<false>, whose queue submission follows its remaining geometry/span checks. Runtime registration enforces allocation extent and queue domain (runtime.cpp:168-190).

T<=INT32_MAX and fixed model dimensions keep every computed byte span below SIZE_MAX on the supported 64-bit PC target. The new multiplications are direct size_t products rather than checked-multiply calls; encode a 64-bit target assertion or checked multiplication if 32-bit builds are in scope.

The recurrence template preserves FP32 recurrence, reductions, recurrent state update and barriers. if constexpr only removes y[idx] assignment; y16 still uses the existing f16_from_f32 conversion. It adds no allocation/arena saving.

Selector defaults OFF, accepts only exact 0/1 and requires native16. Dispatch requires m.native16_active; run_layer_major is entered only for n>m.T, so ordinary short prefill and decode retain existing entrypoints. The default path still calls gdn_recurrence.

validate_device_span proves registration/domain but does not retain Allocation ownership; the API comments state callers must keep allocations and queue alive through asynchronous use. The product caller uses its existing chunk arena and ordered stream. Fixture drains before buffer destruction.

Header declaration is SYCL-guarded; implementation is in the existing SYCL translation unit and reuses its internal recurrence template and included Span/runtime declarations. Source inspection cannot establish compiler acceptance.

fixture.positive_coverage: T=1 and 17 smoke; component adds 256 and 8192. It compares FP32 state and FP16 output bits with the existing kernel, repeats and splits recurrence, covers NaN/Inf output, state/output guards and input immutability.
fixture.refusal_coverage: At T=1 tests each of seven undersized registered allocations, ordinary host input, misaligned output, unordered queue and foreign context/device; also nulls, overlap and zero T.
fixture.gap: No asserted launch counter. Source ordering shows validation precedes submit, but the fixture itself does not count accepted candidate launches or prove rejected cases add zero launches. Add traced smoke accounting before component runs; expected candidate submissions are 2 for T=1 and 4 for T=17, with zero for every refusal; component cases add four each for T=256/8192.
fixture.limits: The fixture does not exercise product default-OFF/short/decode dispatch. Source guards support that claim; after the required profile, retain a native default/short/decode regression and external fault receipt.

remaining_gates: Pending paired model profile has precedence; no test or GPU work was performed in this review.

After profile and foreign CPU work close: apply only against the pinned base; compile the SYCL translation unit and fixture; run a bounded traced smoke with accepted/rejected launch accounting and fault check.

Only if smoke is clean, run component cases and compare model output/state against the same-source FP32+FP16 baseline; then assess longer model quality, performance, RESTORE and physical 262144-context separately.
